Nothing can touch or cross a cell boundary. Cell center positions must be precisely at 1/6, 1/2, 5/6 of the full image width AND height. Row1 picnic basket, mushroom lunchbox, purple sweets gift. Row2 green dew flask, blue ink bottle with quill, refined turquoise ingot. Row3 amber nectar bottle, green mushroom perfume, ice snowflower bottle. Keep crisp exquisite pixel art and the plain deep teal background. No new objects, no grid, no text, no shadows extending outside the icon area. Main purpose: when cropped into nine equal square tiles, each tile shows exactly ONE full object with empty margin and absolutely NO neighboring fragment.
